title: SERAC external memory values as shared-basis Mirror codes
hypothesis: With retrieval keys and routing held fixed, 256 stored counterfactual value vectors on a shared rank-eight subspace can be represented as a shared value basis plus eight coordinates per edit, preserving held-out value RMSE <=0.02 and false-trigger rate <=0.005 while using <=0.75x actual bytes of a SERAC-style explicit value memory. Native PCA and per-value int8 are mandatory simple controls.
physical_object: one 64x8 shared counterfactual value basis plus an unchanged fixed SERAC-like key/router table
mirror_coordinate: eight coefficients for each retrieved counterfactual value
logical_multiplicity: 256 independently addressed counterfactual edit values; 192 train the basis and 64 are held out
controls: SERAC-style explicit float32 values with identical keys/router
ordinary native PCA basis/coefficients using the same fit as Mirror
per-value symmetric int8 quantization with paid scales

task.type: synthetic external edit memory; values lie exactly in a rank-eight value subspace

development.selection_metric: heldout counterfactual value RMSE, false-trigger rate, actual complete memory bytes, retrieval/write operation proxies and wall time

paid_objects: all 256 float32 routing keys and radius metadata
all explicit values OR all code values plus shared basis OR int8 values and scales

compute.query: All methods compare all keys (256*32 distance scalar arithmetic) and report route comparisons; decode adds a selected value vector read, while Mirror adds 64*8 basis decode MACs. SVD/basis fit is one-time and separately timed.

gates.PROMISING: Both development seeds: heldout value RMSE <=0.02, false-trigger rate <=0.005, Mirror actual memory bytes <=0.75x explicit SERAC, <=1.0x int8 memory bytes, and replay passes. Native PCA exact output/payload alias means no Mirror-specific benefit and is a FAIL for attribution.
gates.FAIL: Independent value upper passes but a quality/storage gate fails, int8 is at least as small at equal quality, or native PCA exactly aliases Mirror.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: Explicit upper quality validity fails, route false-trigger rate >0.01, or serialization/metric replay fails.

boundaries: Retrieval keys/router are fixed and paid identically; this isolates value representation only.
Synthetic values are deliberately aligned to a shared rank-eight subspace; this is not factual language-model editing evidence.
Fresh worlds remain sealed unless every frozen PROMISING clause passes; simple native PCA is a required attribution control.
